technique_name: Explain the differences between a formal and an informal letter.
description: Formal letters are written for professional or business purposes and use formal language, whereas informal letters are written for personal communication and can contain informal language. Formal letters use a fixed format or style, use polite language, and avoid using contractions or abbreviations. Informal letters are typically written in a conversational style and may include slang or abbreviations.
